stem.en: Two electrons occupy the same atomic orbital (same n, l, ml). What must be true of their spins?
stem.et: Kaks elektroni hõivavad sama aatomorbitaali (sama n, l, ml). Mis peab kehtima nende spinnide kohta?

label.en: They must have opposite spins — one spin-up and one spin-down — since identical spins would violate the exclusion principle
label.et: Neil peavad olema vastandlikud spinnid — üks spinn-üles ja teine spinn-alla —, kuna identsed spinnid rikuksid keeluprintsiipi

label.en: They must have the same spin, since matching spins are what allows them to share the orbital
label.et: Neil peab olema sama spinn, kuna kokkulangevad spinnid ongi see, mis lubab neil orbitaali jagada

label.en: Their spins are irrelevant, since the exclusion principle only concerns the spatial quantum numbers
label.et: Nende spinnid on ebaolulised, kuna keeluprintsiip puudutab ainult ruumilisi kvantarve

label.en: Both electrons must have zero spin while sharing the orbital
label.et: Mõlemal elektronil peab orbitaali jagades olema null-spinn
